creator: colton.deannn
title: Five Claude Code slash commands: /ultrareview, /effort, /simplify, /loop, /mcp

tools.name: Claude Code /ultrareview
tools.detail: spins up a fleet of cloud agents to hunt bugs in your branch; Pro/Max users get three free until May 5th; screen shows agent-01..agent-05 cards

tools.name: Claude Code /effort
tools.detail: interactive slider from low to 'ultra' showing how hard Claude will work

tools.name: Claude Code /simplify
tools.detail: scans code for redundancy and rewrites tighter (screen: src/handler.ts 89 LOC)

tools.name: Claude Code /loop
tools.detail: run any task on a recurring interval, e.g. check the deploy every 5 minutes (screen: T+05m/T+10m/T+15m deploy passed, '~ git deploy')

tools.name: Claude Code /mcp
tools.detail: after connecting Slack/Notion etc., each shows up as its own slash command (/slack message your team, /notion search your docs, /calendar book a meeting, /drive find a file)

claims: /ultrareview: Pro and Max users get three free runs until May 5th
/loop: 'check the deploy every 5 minutes and then done'
Connected MCP tools appear as their own slash commands
how_to_steps: Type /ultrareview on a branch to launch parallel bug-hunting agents
Type /effort and move the slider to set reasoning effort
Type /mcp after connecting external tools; then use /slack, /notion, /calendar, /drive
on_screen_only: Title card: '5 claude commands to maximize your sessions'
Mock terminal '~/project -- claude-code' with /ultrareview, /effort slider (low ... ultra), /simplify src/handler.ts 89 LOC, /loop timeline, /mcp menu listing /slack, /notion, /calendar, /drive
cta: Comment 'stack' to get a doc to give Claude to make it 10x better

relevance.why: Directly about Claude Code features a solo founder uses daily; /loop and /simplify and /effort map onto real time-saving workflows (this environment confirms /loop, /simplify and code-review skills exist).

implement_score.why: Zero setup: try /effort, /simplify and /loop today; /ultrareview worth a test on a real branch while the free runs last. Skip the comment-gated 'doc'.
